pkgmetadata.longdescription: Chromium's icu4x_datagen tool (tools/crates/icu4x_datagen), which generates the ICU4X baked data Chromium checks in (third_party/rust/icu4x_data) from CLDR, ICU's export data, Unicode's character data, the tzdb and the segmenter's LSTM models. The Chromium ebuild runs it instead of using the checked-in files. Slotted per Chromium major version, built from Chromium's tarball.
